---
title: "Most players' college careers end without going to the NFL, and from their second eligible season the players still in college more often sign undrafted than get drafted"
date: "2026-11-22"
description: "Followed season by season on college rosters, most draft-eligible players at every position run out of eligibility undrafted, from their second eligible season the players still in college more often sign undrafted than get drafted, and players with a matched recruiting record reach the NFL more often by every route."
followups:
  - "Fit cause-specific hazard models of the three endings with position, conference tier and recruiting rating, as the competing-risks baseline for the draft forecast (F17)."
  - "Forecast every player still playing in 2026 (those awaiting their first draft and those back after an undrafted season) before the 2027 draft, then score the forecast once that draft and its undrafted signings are known, as a true out-of-time test."
  - "Check whether the timing of each ending is stable across draft classes before a forecast relies on it."
  - "Compare cause-specific and subdistribution views of position: does a group change how often an ending happens, or how soon?"
  - "Find the roster records CFBD lists before a player enrolled (Joe Burrow at Ohio State the season before he arrived), which start an estimated clock too early."
  - "Find the earlier college years of the NFL entrants outside the risk set (seasons before 2010, when the data starts; junior college; programs the data does not cover): about half were already on a roster in 2010, about half have one season on a roster, and the first season they appear in dates their estimated clock too late."
  - "Add a school guard to the undrafted-signing match, since newly linked signings match the NFL roster's college less often than older links."
author:
  - "AI directed by Nick Giangreco"
freeze: auto
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Most players' college careers end without going to the NFL, and from their second eligible season the players still in college more often sign undrafted than get drafted}
  %\VignetteEngine{quarto::html}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# ---- Packages, data connection and figure defaults -------------------------
# Load the project's functions straight from the checkout with pkgload; the
# repo is never installed (decision 0042). The site build sets CFB2NFL_ROOT,
# a local render finds the checkout from the working directory.
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) {
  root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(duckdb)
library(ggiraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

# One interaction style for every girafe figure: a clear hover pop, dimming
# of non-hovered marks, a dark tooltip, and toolbar zoom + PNG download.
set_girafe_defaults(
  opts_hover = opts_hover(
    css = "stroke:#111827;stroke-width:2.5px;filter:brightness(1.12);"
  ),
  opts_hover_inv = opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.45;"),
  opts_tooltip = opts_tooltip(
    css = "background:#111827;color:#fff;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:5px;font-weight:bold;font-size:15px;"
  ),
  opts_zoom = opts_zoom(min = 1, max = 5),
  opts_toolbar = opts_toolbar(saveaspng = TRUE, position = "topright"),
  opts_sizing = opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE)
)

# thousands-separated and percent formatters for inline numbers
fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  formatC(as.numeric(x), big.mark = ",", format = "f", digits = digits)
}
pct <- function(x, digits = 1) sprintf("%.*f%%", digits, 100 * x)
per100 <- function(x) round(100 * x)
per100_1 <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f", 100 * x)

# One color per ending, shared by every figure; the two NFL routes carry the
# color, the endings without the NFL stay gray.
ending_lab <- ending_labels()
state_lab <- c(ending_lab, playing = "Still playing")
state_fill <- c(
  "Drafted" = "#1B9E77",
  "Signed undrafted" = "#7570B3",
  "Eligibility ended, undrafted" = "#6B7280",
  "Left the data" = "#D1D5DB",
  "Still playing" = "#E5E7EB"
)
claim_color <- "#B45309"
rec_lines <- c(
  `Matched recruiting record` = "solid",
  `No matched recruiting record` = "dashed"
)
context_color <- "#9CA3AF"

# ---- Named players (keyed on athlete id) -----------------------------------
# Key on athlete id, never name (recruiting ids collide, decision 0013).
# One example per ending plus a missed season; Burrow appears only in the
# caveats, since his roster record starts before he enrolled.
subjects <- tibble::tribble(
  ~who               , ~cfb_athlete_id , ~in_cast ,
  "Jordan Travis"    , "4360799"       , TRUE     ,
  "Shane Buechele"   , "4039034"       , TRUE     ,
  "Zane Zandier"     , "4240855"       , TRUE     ,
  "Grant Calcaterra" , "4241374"       , TRUE     ,
  "Joe Burrow"       , "3915511"       , FALSE
)

# ---- Load the tables -------------------------------------------------------
outcomes <- dbReadTable(con, "outcomes")
# One position and team per player-season (a handful of ids repeat).
roster_pos <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT playerId, season, any_value(position) AS position,
          any_value(team) AS team
   FROM roster GROUP BY playerId, season"
)
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
data_date <- format(
  file.mtime(file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb")),
  "%Y-%m-%d"
)

pos_levels <- position_group_levels()
endings <- career_endings(outcomes, select(roster_pos, -team)) |>
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, c(pos_levels, "Position not recorded")),
    recruited = if_else(
      hs_year_imputed,
      "No matched recruiting record",
      "Matched recruiting record"
    )
  )
never <- never_eligible_entrants(outcomes, select(roster_pos, -team))
comparable <- function(df) filter(df, group != "Position not recorded")

# ---- 2.1 The study population --------------------------------------------------
n_players <- nrow(endings)
n_never <- nrow(never)
first_data_season <- min(outcomes$season)
never_seasons <- outcomes |>
  filter(playerId %in% never$playerId) |>
  summarise(n = n(), first = min(season), .by = "playerId")
never_one_season <- mean(never_seasons$n == 1)
# Careers already under way in the first season the data covers: the clock
# starts from that season, so it runs late.
never_window <- mean(never_seasons$first == first_data_season)
n_missed <- sum(endings$missed_season)
# Players in the study population by the eligible season their career ended
# in, or (still playing) the last eligible season counted for them.
season_counts <- endings |>
  comparable() |>
  mutate(
    group = droplevels(group),
    state = if_else(ending == "censored", "playing", ending)
  ) |>
  count(group, state, time) |>
  tidyr::complete(
    group,
    state,
    time = 0:max(endings$time),
    fill = list(n = 0L)
  ) |>
  # No career can end before its first eligible season.
  filter(state == "playing" | time > 0) |>
  mutate(
    label = factor(state_lab[state], names(state_fill)),
    share = n / sum(n),
    .by = "group"
  ) |>
  # A "left the data" ending is drawn only when some player has one.
  filter(sum(n) > 0, .by = "state")
# One color per position group.
position_color <- c(
  "#1F77B4",
  "#FF7F0E",
  "#2CA02C",
  "#D62728",
  "#9467BD",
  "#8C564B",
  "#E377C2",
  "#17BECF",
  "#BCBD22"
)
# The flow from every roster player down to the study population: each
# main box splits into the next, and the players set aside branch off the
# trunk between them.
n_roster <- n_distinct(outcomes$playerId)
n_no_pos <- sum(endings$group == "Position not recorded")
study_pop <- comparable(endings)
# A player awaiting his first draft is censored at season 0: still playing,
# with no completed eligible season, so he is in no season's at-risk count.
n_awaiting <- sum(study_pop$time == 0)
current_season <- max(outcomes$season)
step <- 2.3 # vertical distance between flow rows, in y units
flow_main <- tibble::tibble(
  label = c(
    "Players on a college roster",
    "Draft-eligible",
    "Study population"
  ),
  n = c(n_roster, n_players, nrow(study_pop)),
  # the first gap holds two side boxes
  y = c(4.65, 3, 2) * step
) |>
  mutate(
    share = n / lag(n),
    box = if_else(
      is.na(share),
      sprintf("%s\n%s", label, fmt(n)),
      sprintf("%s\n%s (%s)", label, fmt(n), pct(share))
    )
  )
# Each side box's percent is of the main box above it. Players who reach the
# NFL before the clock makes them eligible break the NFL's three-year rule,
# so the data has missed part of their career: they are ruled out.
flow_side <- tibble::tibble(
  label = c(
    sprintf(
      "Never draft-eligible\n(left early, or not yet old enough)\n%s (%s)",
      fmt(n_roster - n_players - n_never),
      pct((n_roster - n_players - n_never) / n_roster)
    ),
    sprintf(
      "Ruled out: reached the NFL before\nthe clock made them eligible\n(earlier college years missing)\n%s (%s)",
      fmt(n_never),
      pct(n_never / n_roster)
    ),
    sprintf(
      "Position not recorded\n%s (%s)",
      fmt(n_no_pos),
      pct(n_no_pos / n_players)
    )
  ),
  y = c(4.65 * step - 1.05, 4.65 * step - 2.55, 3 * step - 1.25)
)
flow_end <- study_pop |>
  mutate(state = if_else(ending == "censored", "playing", ending)) |>
  count(state) |>
  mutate(
    label = factor(state_lab[state], names(state_fill)),
    share = n / nrow(study_pop)
  ) |>
  arrange(label) |>
  mutate(
    x = seq(-3.3, 3.3, length.out = n()),
    # Still playing is the censored leaf: no ending observed yet.
    box = sprintf(
      "%s%s\n%s (%s)%s",
      label,
      if_else(state == "playing", " (censored)", ""),
      fmt(n),
      pct(share),
      if_else(
        state == "playing",
        sprintf("\n%s of them awaiting\ntheir first draft", fmt(n_awaiting)),
        ""
      )
    ),
    text_color = if_else(
      state %in% c("left_data", "playing"),
      "#111827",
      "#FFFFFF"
    )
  )

# ---- 2.2 The named players ---------------------------------------------
last_team <- outcomes |>
  summarise(last = max(season), .by = "playerId") |>
  left_join(
    select(roster_pos, playerId, season, team),
    by = c("playerId", "last" = "season")
  )
cast <- subjects |>
  filter(in_cast) |>
  inner_join(endings, by = c("cfb_athlete_id" = "playerId")) |>
  left_join(last_team, by = c("cfb_athlete_id" = "playerId")) |>
  mutate(
    url = explorer_player_url(cfb_athlete_id, as.character(group)),
    Player = if_else(is.na(url), who, sprintf("[%s](%s)", who, url)),
    Ending = case_when(
      ending == "drafted" ~ sprintf("Drafted, round %d", round),
      .default = unname(ending_lab[ending])
    ),
    order = match(ending, names(ending_lab))
  ) |>
  arrange(order, desc(missed_season), hs_year_imputed)
returner <- cast[cast$who == "Grant Calcaterra", ]
and_list <- function(x) sub(", ([^,]*)$", " and \\1", paste(x, collapse = ", "))
ordinal <- function(n) c("first", "second", "third", "fourth", "fifth")[n]

# ---- 3.1 Cumulative percents by position ------------------------------------
horizon <- 3L
# Fewest players at risk for a group's curve or bar to be shown.
min_curve <- 30
ci <- ending_incidence(endings)
ci_all <- ending_incidence(endings, by = NULL)
at_horizon_all <- ci |>
  filter(time == horizon) |>
  comparable()
thin_groups <- at_horizon_all |>
  filter(n_risk < min_curve) |>
  distinct(group) |>
  pull(group) |>
  as.character()
at_horizon <- at_horizon_all |>
  filter(!group %in% thin_groups) |>
  mutate(label = factor(state_lab[state], names(state_fill)))
nfl_share <- at_horizon |>
  filter(state %in% c("drafted", "signed_udfa")) |>
  summarise(nfl = sum(estimate), .by = "group") |>
  arrange(desc(nfl))
exhausted_share <- at_horizon |>
  filter(state == "exhausted_undrafted") |>
  arrange(estimate)
omitted_note <- if (length(thin_groups)) {
  sprintf(
    " Omitted, with fewer than %d players at risk: %s.",
    min_curve,
    paste(tolower(thin_groups), collapse = ", ")
  )
} else {
  ""
}
e1_holds <- any(nfl_share$nfl > 0.5)

# ---- 3.2 From the risk set to the chance of each NFL route ---------------
# Each season's players at risk and drafted, per group; the first figure
# draws the quarterbacks.
draft_steps <- ending_hazards(endings) |>
  comparable() |>
  filter(ending == "drafted", at_risk >= min_curve) |>
  transmute(group, time, at_risk, drafted = events, chance = hazard)
qb_steps <- filter(draft_steps, group == "Quarterback")
# Either NFL route, estimated as one ending so it carries its own interval.
nfl_ci <- endings |>
  mutate(ending = if_else(ending == "signed_udfa", "drafted", ending)) |>
  ending_incidence() |>
  filter(state == "drafted") |>
  mutate(state = "nfl")
route_lab <- c(
  drafted = "Drafted",
  signed_udfa = "Signed undrafted",
  nfl = "Either NFL route"
)
route_color <- c(
  Drafted = state_fill[["Drafted"]],
  `Signed undrafted` = state_fill[["Signed undrafted"]],
  `Either NFL route` = "#374151"
)
route_ci <- ci |>
  filter(state %in% c("drafted", "signed_udfa")) |>
  bind_rows(nfl_ci) |>
  comparable() |>
  filter(n_risk >= min_curve, !group %in% thin_groups) |>
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, pos_levels),
    route = factor(route_lab[state], route_lab)
  )

# ---- 3.3 The per-season chance of each NFL route ---------------------------
# Too few players at risk make a per-season rate noise.
min_risk <- 500
hz_all <- ending_hazards(comparable(endings), by = NULL) |>
  filter(ending %in% c("drafted", "signed_udfa"), at_risk >= min_risk)
hz_at <- function(s, t) hz_all$hazard[hz_all$ending == s & hz_all$time == t]
hz_wide <- hz_all |>
  select(time, ending, hazard) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = ending, values_from = hazard)
cross_season <- min(hz_wide$time[hz_wide$signed_udfa > hz_wide$drafted])
draft_peak <- hz_wide$time[which.max(hz_wide$drafted)]
last_hz <- max(hz_wide$time)
e3_holds <- all(diff(hz_wide$drafted) > 0)
hz_group <- ending_hazards(endings) |>
  comparable() |>
  filter(
    ending %in% c("drafted", "signed_udfa"),
    at_risk >= min_curve,
    !group %in% thin_groups
  ) |>
  mutate(group = factor(group, pos_levels))

# ---- 3.4 Recruited and unrecruited players ---------------------------------
share_recruited <- mean(!study_pop$hs_year_imputed)
# Each NFL route, and either one estimated as a single ending so it carries
# its own interval, as in 3.3.
route_incidence <- function(df, by) {
  either <- df |>
    mutate(ending = if_else(ending == "signed_udfa", "drafted", ending)) |>
    ending_incidence(by = by) |>
    filter(state == "drafted") |>
    mutate(state = "nfl")
  ending_incidence(df, by = by) |>
    filter(state %in% c("drafted", "signed_udfa")) |>
    bind_rows(either) |>
    mutate(route = factor(route_lab[state], route_lab))
}
rec_routes <- route_incidence(study_pop, "recruited")
rec_routes_group <- study_pop |>
  mutate(cell = paste(group, recruited, sep = "|")) |>
  route_incidence("cell") |>
  tidyr::separate_wider_delim(cell, "|", names = c("group", "recruited")) |>
  filter(!group %in% thin_groups) |>
  mutate(group = factor(group, pos_levels))
rec_at <- function(s, who, t = horizon) {
  rec_routes$estimate[
    rec_routes$state == s & rec_routes$recruited == who & rec_routes$time == t
  ]
}
rec_ratio_of <- function(s) {
  rec_at(s, "Matched recruiting record") /
    rec_at(s, "No matched recruiting record")
}
rec_ratio <- rec_ratio_of("drafted")
udfa_ratio <- rec_ratio_of("signed_udfa")
nfl_ratio <- rec_ratio_of("nfl")
e4_holds <- rec_ratio > 1
# Each group's percents by the horizon season, matched record or not.
rec_table <- rec_routes_group |>
  filter(time == horizon) |>
  select(group, recruited, route, estimate) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = recruited, values_from = estimate)
rec_exceptions <- rec_table |>
  filter(
    route == "Drafted",
    `Matched recruiting record` <= `No matched recruiting record`
  ) |>
  pull(group) |>
  as.character()
rec_where <- if (length(rec_exceptions)) {
  paste("at every position but", and_list(tolower(rec_exceptions)))
} else {
  "at every position"
}
# Joe Burrow's roster record starts the season before he enrolled.
burrow_id <- subjects$cfb_athlete_id[subjects$who == "Joe Burrow"]
burrow_first <- min(outcomes$season[outcomes$playerId == burrow_id])
burrow_team <- roster_pos$team[
  roster_pos$playerId == burrow_id & roster_pos$season == burrow_first
][1]
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
*Data as of the `data-latest` release, retrieved `r data_date`. Draft classes
after the last complete draft are right-censored: a player whose next
outcome is not yet known counts as still playing up to his last known
season, never as a career that ended.*
:::

## 1. Introduction

Out of every 100 college players who become draft-eligible, how many are
drafted, how many sign with an NFL team undrafted, and how many run out of
eligibility with neither, and does another season in college change those
odds? This post follows `r fmt(nrow(study_pop))` draft-eligible players
season by season, counting their eligible seasons, until each career ends
one of those three ways.

+ *Expecting at least one position group where most eligible players reach
  the NFL by their `r ordinal(horizon)` eligible season.*
+ *Expecting players still in college to be likelier to be drafted with each
  extra eligible season.*
+ *Expecting players with a matched recruiting record to be drafted more
  often than players without one.*

## 2. Data

### 2.1 `r fmt(nrow(study_pop))` of `r fmt(n_roster)` college roster players make up the study population

The table defines the terms, the flow chart narrows every roster player to
the study population and its endings, and the last figure splits those
endings by position group and the eligible season each career ended in.

```{r}
#| label: terms
tibble::tribble(
  ~Term                          , ~Meaning                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             ,
  "Eligible season"              , "A season on a college roster after which the next NFL draft could select the player (at least three years after high school). Season 1 is his first such season: for a player who enrolled straight from high school, his third college season, redshirt or not. The clock starts here, not at his first college season, because before it the NFL can neither draft nor sign him. His high-school year comes from his recruiting record or, when none can be matched, is estimated as the year of his first college season, as for a player who enrolled straight from high school." ,
  "Drafted"                      , "Selected in the NFL draft after that season, or after a later season off every roster."                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             ,
  "Signed undrafted"             , "Not drafted, and first on an NFL roster the following season."                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ,
  "Eligibility ended, undrafted" , "His last season on a college roster, with no NFL outcome, for any reason: eligibility used up, leaving early undrafted and unsigned, quitting or a medical retirement, a transfer to a program the data does not cover, or an NFL signing more than a season later."                                                                                                                                                                                                ,
  "Still playing"                , sprintf("Censored: eligible, his career not yet ended, and on a roster in %s, the season under way, so his next draft has not happened. The curves count him through his last completed eligible season.", current_season)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           ,
  "Awaiting first draft"         , sprintf("Still playing with no eligible season completed yet: first eligible in %s. Censored at season 0, he is in no season's at-risk count yet. He and the other players still playing are the players a forecast would predict.", current_season)                                                                                                                                                                                                                 ,
  "Study population"             , "Every draft-eligible player whose position is recorded; every curve, rate and count in the results describes them."                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 ,
  "Ruled out"                    , sprintf("Drafted or signed before his first eligible season by the clock, which the NFL's three-year rule does not allow, so the data has missed part of his college career: %s were already on a roster in %s, the first season the data covers, and %s appear on a roster for a single season. Left out of the study population.", pct(never_window, 0), first_data_season, pct(never_one_season, 0))                                                              ,
  "Missed season"                , "A season off every college roster in the data (a medical retirement, a transfer to a program the data does not cover) followed by a return; not an ending, since a career ends only in his final eligible season. A missed season does not advance the clock."                                                                                                                                                                                                      ,
  "Position group"               , sprintf("His roster position in his first eligible season, in the %d groups of the [earlier position post](2026-10-24-draft-eligibility-by-position.html).", length(pos_levels))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     ,
  "Cumulative percent"           , "Of the group's eligible players, the percent whose career has ended a given way by a given season. It is a running total that applies each season's chance only to the players whose careers have not yet ended and counts a player still playing only through the seasons he has played (the Aalen-Johansen estimate), so each season's three percents plus the percent still playing add to 100%. A simple share of all eligible players would count a player still playing as never drafted, and so understate every ending."                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ,
  "At risk"                      , "Players still playing going into a season, the denominator for that season."                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ,
  "95% interval"                 , "The range the true share plausibly occupies given how many players are behind it; wider when fewer players are at risk."                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ,
  "Per-season chance"            , "Of players still playing going into a season, the share whose career ends a given way that season."
) |>
  kable(caption = "The terms used throughout the post.")
```

```{r}
#| label: risk-flow
#| fig-width: 13
#| fig-height: 9
h <- 0.5 # half a main box's height, in y units
bar_y <- min(flow_main$y) - 1.1
end_y <- bar_y - 1.25
side_x <- 0.7
p22 <- ggplot() +
  # main trunk, one arrow per step down
  geom_segment(
    data = tibble::tibble(
      y = head(flow_main$y, -1),
      yend = tail(flow_main$y, -1)
    ),
    aes(x = 0, xend = 0, y = y - h, yend = yend + h),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm"), type = "closed"),
    color = "#4B5563",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  # each side branch leaves the trunk below the box it splits from
  geom_segment(
    data = flow_side,
    aes(x = 0, xend = side_x - 0.05, y = y, yend = y),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm"), type = "closed"),
    color = "#4B5563",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  # the split into the endings
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 0,
    xend = 0,
    y = min(flow_main$y) - h,
    yend = bar_y,
    color = "#4B5563",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = min(flow_end$x),
    xend = max(flow_end$x),
    y = bar_y,
    yend = bar_y,
    color = "#4B5563",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = flow_end,
    aes(x = x, xend = x, y = bar_y, yend = end_y + h),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm"), type = "closed"),
    color = "#4B5563",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = flow_main,
    aes(0, y, label = box),
    size = 5.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    fill = "#FFFFFF",
    color = "#111827",
    label.padding = unit(0.6, "lines"),
    label.r = unit(0.3, "lines"),
    lineheight = 1.1
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = flow_side,
    aes(side_x, y, label = label),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold",
    fill = "#F3F4F6",
    color = "#374151",
    label.padding = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    label.r = unit(0.3, "lines"),
    lineheight = 1.1
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = flow_end,
    aes(
      x,
      end_y + h,
      label = box,
      fill = label,
      color = text_color
    ),
    # top-aligned, so a taller box still meets its arrow
    vjust = 1,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold",
    label.padding = unit(0.6, "lines"),
    label.r = unit(0.3, "lines"),
    lineheight = 1.1
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = state_fill, guide = "none") +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-4.4, 4.6)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(end_y - 1, max(flow_main$y) + 0.6)) +
  labs(
    title = "From every roster player to the study population",
    subtitle = "Each box is a count of players and its percent of the box above it"
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )
p22
```

## 3. Results

### 3.1 No more than `r per100(max(nfl_share$nfl))` in 100 eligible players at any position have gone into the NFL by their `r ordinal(horizon)` eligible season

*Expecting at least one position group where most eligible players reach
the NFL by their `r ordinal(horizon)` eligible season.* ❌

The first figure stacks each group's cumulative percents at season
`r horizon`, where `r tolower(nfl_share$group[1])` players go into the NFL
most, `r per100(nfl_share$nfl[1])` in 100, while at least
`r floor(100 * exhausted_share$estimate[1])` in 100 in every group have run
out of eligibility undrafted; the second figure follows the NFL routes
season by season.

```{r}
#| label: s31-explain
#| fig-height: 7
p31 <- at_horizon |>
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, rev(as.character(nfl_share$group))),
    tooltip = sprintf(
      "%s, season %d: %s %s (95%% CI %s to %s; %s players at risk going into season %d)",
      group,
      time,
      pct(estimate),
      tolower(label),
      pct(lower),
      pct(upper),
      fmt(n_risk),
      time
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(100 * estimate, group, fill = label)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    # group = label keeps the stack in ending order; data_id would otherwise
    # set the stacking groups.
    aes(tooltip = tooltip, data_id = paste(group, state), group = label),
    width = 0.75,
    color = "#9CA3AF",
    linewidth = 0.3,
    position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +
  # the top group's NFL segments, the claim's element
  geom_col(
    data = \(d) filter(d, group == nfl_share$group[1], state %in% c("drafted", "signed_udfa")),
    aes(group = label),
    fill = NA,
    color = claim_color,
    linewidth = 1.4,
    width = 0.75,
    position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", color = "#111827") +
  annotate(
    "label",
    x = 50,
    y = length(nfl_share$group) + 0.8,
    label = "half",
    size = 4.4,
    fontface = "bold",
    label.size = 0
  ) +
  # each segment's percent, dark on the light segments
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = pct(estimate, 0),
      group = label,
      color = label %in% c("Left the data", "Still playing")
    ),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5, reverse = TRUE),
    size = 4.6,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(`FALSE` = "#FFFFFF", `TRUE` = "#111827"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = state_fill) +
  # room above the top bar for the "half" label
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.6, 1.1))) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.01))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = sprintf(
      "Most players at every position have not gone into the NFL by their %s eligible season",
      ordinal(horizon)
    ),
    subtitle = "Cumulative percent of eligible players by how their college careers had ended",
    x = "Percent of the group's eligible players",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    caption = paste0(
      sprintf(
        "Cumulative percents counting all three endings; the outlined segments are %s players' NFL routes.",
        tolower(nfl_share$group[1])
      ),
      omitted_note,
      "\nHover a segment for its interval and players at risk."
    )
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl() +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2))
girafe(ggobj = p31, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 7)
```

### 3.2 Counting only the quarterbacks still playing, the chance of being drafted goes from `r per100_1(qb_steps$chance[1])` in 100 in the first eligible season to `r per100_1(qb_steps$chance[horizon])` in 100 in the `r ordinal(horizon)`

Quarterbacks are the worked example for the per-season chances of 3.3: each
season's chance divides that season's drafted players by the players still
at risk going in, a count set by how many were drafted, signed, ran out of
eligibility or are still playing (censored) in the seasons before.
Unlike all positions pooled in 3.3, the quarterbacks' chance keeps rising,
though the `r ordinal(nrow(qb_steps))` season rests on
`r qb_steps$drafted[nrow(qb_steps)]` drafted of
`r qb_steps$at_risk[nrow(qb_steps)]` at risk.

```{r}
#| label: s32-step1
#| column: page
# Each quarterback's state going into every eligible season: still playing
# (at risk) while his clock has not passed his last season, then the way his
# career ended, carried forward. The flows between two seasons are then the
# players who kept playing, and those who ended each way that season.
qb_last <- max(qb_steps$time)
flow_lab <- c(
  playing = "Playing",
  drafted = "Drafted",
  signed_udfa = "Signed undrafted",
  left_data = "Left the data",
  censored = "Still playing (censored)",
  exhausted_undrafted = "Eligibility ended, undrafted"
)
flow_color <- c(
  playing = "#374151",
  drafted = state_fill[["Drafted"]],
  signed_udfa = state_fill[["Signed undrafted"]],
  exhausted_undrafted = state_fill[["Eligibility ended, undrafted"]],
  left_data = state_fill[["Left the data"]],
  censored = "#C4C8CE"
)
qb_states <- endings |>
  filter(group == "Quarterback", time > 0) |>
  select(playerId, time, ending) |>
  tidyr::expand_grid(axis = seq_len(qb_last + 1)) |>
  mutate(state = if_else(time >= axis, "playing", ending))
qb_links <- qb_states |>
  mutate(to = lead(state), .by = "playerId") |>
  filter(axis <= qb_last) |>
  count(axis, from = state, to) |>
  mutate(at_risk = sum(n[from == "playing"]), .by = "axis")
qb_nodes <- qb_states |>
  count(axis, state) |>
  mutate(state = factor(state, names(flow_lab))) |>
  arrange(axis, state) |>
  mutate(id = row_number() - 1L) |>
  # nodes stack top to bottom in state order within each season
  mutate(y = (cumsum(n) - n / 2) / sum(n) * 0.9 + 0.05, .by = "axis") |>
  mutate(
    x = (axis - 1) / qb_last * 0.98 + 0.01,
    axis_lab = if_else(
      axis > qb_last,
      sprintf("after season %d", qb_last),
      sprintf("going into season %d", axis)
    ),
    # counts are written around the flows, not on the nodes
    label = "",
    hover = sprintf("%s %s, %s", fmt(n), tolower(flow_lab[state]), axis_lab)
  )
node_id <- function(axis, state) {
  qb_nodes$id[match(paste(axis, state), paste(qb_nodes$axis, qb_nodes$state))]
}
qb_links <- qb_links |>
  mutate(
    source = node_id(axis, from),
    target = node_id(axis + 1L, to),
    hover = case_when(
      from == "playing" & to == "playing" ~ sprintf(
        "Season %d: %s of %s at risk played again the next season",
        axis,
        fmt(n),
        fmt(at_risk)
      ),
      from == "playing" ~ sprintf(
        "Season %d: %s of %s at risk (%s): %s",
        axis,
        fmt(n),
        fmt(at_risk),
        pct(n / at_risk),
        tolower(flow_lab[to])
      ),
      TRUE ~ sprintf(
        "%s %s before season %d",
        fmt(n),
        tolower(flow_lab[from]),
        axis + 1L
      )
    ),
    # the players who keep playing stay darkest, the large eligibility-ended
    # flows lightest, so the at-risk path reads first
    color = paste0(
      flow_color[if_else(from == "playing", to, from)],
      case_when(
        to == "playing" ~ "B3",
        to == "exhausted_undrafted" ~ "4D",
        TRUE ~ "99"
      )
    )
  )
# The flows take the left part of the width; the endings are labelled to
# the right of the last column.
flow_width <- 0.8
end_notes <- qb_nodes |>
  filter(axis > qb_last) |>
  mutate(
    text = sprintf(
      "%s %s",
      fmt(n),
      c(
        drafted = "drafted",
        signed_udfa = "signed undrafted",
        exhausted_undrafted = "eligibility ended,<br>undrafted",
        left_data = "left the data",
        censored = "still playing<br>(censored)"
      )[as.character(state)]
    )
  )
end_notes <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(end_notes)), function(i) {
  list(
    x = flow_width + 0.01,
    y = 1 - end_notes$y[i],
    xref = "paper",
    yref = "paper",
    xanchor = "left",
    yanchor = "middle",
    align = "left",
    showarrow = FALSE,
    font = list(size = 15, color = "#111827"),
    text = end_notes$text[i]
  )
})
# each season's players at risk, written above its column
risk_notes <- qb_nodes |>
  filter(state == "playing")
risk_notes <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(risk_notes)), function(i) {
  list(
    x = risk_notes$x[i] * flow_width,
    y = 1.02,
    xref = "paper",
    yref = "paper",
    xanchor = "center",
    yanchor = "bottom",
    showarrow = FALSE,
    font = list(size = 15, color = "#111827"),
    text = sprintf("<b>%s</b> at risk", fmt(risk_notes$n[i]))
  )
})
# each season's chance of being drafted, written under its flows
chance_notes <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(qb_steps)), function(i) {
  list(
    x = ((qb_steps$time[i] - 0.5) / qb_last * 0.98 + 0.01) * flow_width,
    y = -0.08,
    xref = "paper",
    yref = "paper",
    xanchor = "center",
    showarrow = FALSE,
    font = list(size = 15, color = state_fill[["Drafted"]]),
    text = sprintf(
      "<b>Season %d</b><br>%s / %s at risk<br>= %s drafted",
      qb_steps$time[i],
      fmt(qb_steps$drafted[i]),
      fmt(qb_steps$at_risk[i]),
      pct(qb_steps$chance[i])
    )
  )
})
plotly::plot_ly(
  type = "sankey",
  arrangement = "fixed",
  domain = list(x = c(0, flow_width)),
  node = list(
    label = qb_nodes$label,
    x = qb_nodes$x,
    y = qb_nodes$y,
    color = unname(flow_color[as.character(qb_nodes$state)]),
    customdata = qb_nodes$hover,
    hovertemplate = "%{customdata}<extra></extra>",
    pad = 12,
    thickness = 18,
    line = list(width = 0)
  ),
  link = list(
    source = qb_links$source,
    target = qb_links$target,
    value = qb_links$n,
    color = qb_links$color,
    customdata = qb_links$hover,
    hovertemplate = "%{customdata}<extra></extra>"
  ),
  height = 640
) |>
  plotly::layout(
    title = list(
      text = paste0(
        "<b>How quarterbacks leave the risk set, season by season</b><br>",
        "<span style='font-size:15px;color:#4B5563'>Quarterbacks still playing ",
        "(dark) flow into the next season or out to an ending</span>"
      ),
      x = 0.01,
      font = list(size = 20)
    ),
    font = list(size = 15),
    margin = list(t = 140, b = 110, l = 60, r = 10),
    annotations = c(risk_notes, chance_notes, end_notes)
  )
```

### 3.3 Of the players still in college, at most `r per100_1(hz_at("drafted", draft_peak))` in 100 are drafted in any of the first `r last_hz` eligible seasons, and from their `r ordinal(cross_season)` eligible season on more of them sign undrafted than get drafted

*Expecting players still in college to be likelier to be drafted with each
extra eligible season.* ❌

Of every 100 players still playing, `r per100_1(hz_at("drafted", 1))` are
drafted after their first eligible season, a share that rises through
season `r draft_peak` to `r per100_1(hz_at("drafted", draft_peak))` and falls to
`r per100_1(hz_at("drafted", last_hz))` in season `r last_hz`, while the share signing undrafted climbs from
`r per100_1(hz_at("signed_udfa", 1))` to `r per100_1(hz_at("signed_udfa", last_hz))`
by season `r last_hz`; the second figure gives the same chances for each
position group.

```{r}
#| label: s33-explain
#| fig-height: 6
hz_lab <- c(drafted = "Drafted", signed_udfa = "Signed undrafted")
p33 <- ggplot(hz_all, aes(time, 100 * hazard, color = hz_lab[ending])) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.8) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "All positions, season %d: %s %s (95%% CI %s to %s; %s of %s at risk)",

        tolower(hz_lab[ending]),
        pct(lower),
        pct(upper),
        fmt(events),

    ),

  ) +
  annotate(

    ),
```

### 3.4 Players with a matched recruiting record reach the NFL `r sprintf("%.1f", nfl_ratio)` times as often by season `r horizon` as the rest: drafted `r sprintf("%.1f", rec_ratio)` times and signed undrafted `r sprintf("%.1f", udfa_ratio)` times as often

*Expecting players with a matched recruiting record to be drafted more
often than players without one.* ✅

The `r pct(share_recruited, 0)` of the study population with a matched
recruiting record are `r sprintf("%.1f", rec_ratio)` times as likely as the
rest to be drafted by season `r horizon`, all positions together in the first
figure, and the second figure shows the gap holds `r rec_where`.

```{r}
#| label: s34-explain
#| fig-height: 6
rec_gap <- rec_routes |>
  filter(time == horizon) |>
  select(route, recruited, estimate) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = recruited, values_from = estimate) |>
  mutate(
    ratio = `Matched recruiting record` / `No matched recruiting record`,
    y = 100 * `Matched recruiting record`
  )
p34 <- rec_routes |>
  filter(n_risk >= min_curve) |>
  mutate(
    tooltip = sprintf(
      "All positions, %s, by season %d: %s %s (95%% CI %s to %s; %s at risk)",
      tolower(recruited),
      time,
      pct(estimate),
      tolower(route),
      pct(lower),
      pct(upper),
      fmt(n_risk)
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    time,
    100 * estimate,
    color = route,
    fill = route,
    linetype = recruited,
    group = recruited
  )) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = 100 * lower, ymax = 100 * upper),
    alpha = 0.12,
    color = NA,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.3) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tooltip, data_id = paste(state, recruited, time)),
    size = 2.6
  ) +
  # the season-3 gap, the claim's element
  geom_label(
    data = rec_gap,
    aes(
      x = horizon,
      y = y,
      label = sprintf("%.1f times as often\nby season %d", ratio, horizon)
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 1.05,
    vjust = -0.2,
    size = 4.4,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = claim_color,
    label.size = 0
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~route, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = route_color, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = route_color, guide = "none") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = rec_lines) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  labs(
    title = "Players with a matched recruiting record reach every NFL route more often",
    subtitle = "Cumulative percent of eligible players, all positions, matched recruiting record (solid) or not (dashed), with 95% intervals",
    x = "Eligible season",
    y = "Cumulative percent",
    linetype = NULL,
    caption = sprintf(
      "Seasons with fewer than %d players at risk are omitted; hover a point for its interval.",
      min_curve
    )
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl() +
  # a long legend key, so the dashed line reads as dashed
  guides(
    linetype = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(color = "#374151", linewidth = 1.1),
      keywidth = unit(4, "lines")
    )
  )
girafe(ggobj = p34, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

```{r}
    x = "Eligible season",

girafe(ggobj = p34b, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 16)
```

## 4. Summary

Followed to the end of their college careers, most eligible players in
every group run out of eligibility undrafted, no more than
`r per100(max(nfl_share$nfl))` in 100 at any position reach the NFL by their
`r ordinal(horizon)` eligible season, players still in college more often
sign undrafted than get drafted from their `r ordinal(cross_season)`
eligible season, and players with a matched recruiting record reach the NFL
`r round(nfl_ratio, 1)` times as often as the rest by their
`r ordinal(horizon)` eligible season.

```{r}
#| label: summary
tibble::tribble(
  ~Expectation                                                                            , ~Verdict                   , ~Evidence                                                                                                                                                                                          ,
  sprintf("Most eligible players at some position go into the NFL by season %d", horizon) , if (e1_holds) "✅" else "❌" , sprintf("The highest among groups shown, %s, is %s", tolower(nfl_share$group[1]), pct(nfl_share$nfl[1]))                                                                                           ,
  "Players still in college are likelier to be drafted with each extra eligible season"   , if (e3_holds) "✅" else "❌" , sprintf("Their drafted rate peaks in season %d at %s, then is lower in season %d", draft_peak, pct(hz_at("drafted", draft_peak)), last_hz)                                                         ,
  "Players with a matched recruiting record are drafted more often"                       , if (e4_holds) "✅" else "❌" , sprintf("%s with a matched record against %s without, drafted by season %d", pct(rec_at("drafted", "Matched recruiting record")), pct(rec_at("drafted", "No matched recruiting record")), horizon)
) |>
  kable(caption = "Each expectation and what the data showed.")
```

## 5. Discussion

::: {.callout-important}
The NFL routes compete with each other and with the end of eligibility.

- The longer players stay in college, the more of them sign undrafted
  rather than get drafted, so a forecast that pools the two routes, or
  ignores the endings that compete with them, mixes processes that grow at
  different rates.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
The NFL routes move with the recruiting record.

- Players with a matched recruiting record reach every NFL route far more often,
  likely partly as stronger prospects and partly because an estimated clock
  can start early or late.
:::

Several caveats bound these figures. The population is every player on a
college roster, walk-ons and scout-team players included, so each group's
drafted share describes everyone a program carried, not only its regulars. Some
roster records begin before the player enrolled (Joe Burrow's starts in
`r burrow_first`, at `r burrow_team`), which starts an estimated clock early. A
missed season mixes medical retirements, sit-outs and transfers to programs
the data does not cover. Position is fixed at the first eligible season, so a
player who changed position later is counted at his first one. The most
recent classes are right-censored, and their later seasons carry fewer
players at risk.
